desc: Refined, capable, and easy to carry, the Celestion brings elevated style to everyday carry. This DuraLock folder opens smoothly with manual KVT ball bearings and provides confident, easy-to-use lockup for daily tasks. The two-tone D2 blade combines satin grinds with stonewashed flats, delivering dependable cutting performance with a clean, modern look. Contoured, polished G10 handles offer a comfortable grip while maintaining a slim profile that carries easily in the pocket. Blue PVD accents on the pivot and tube spacers add a subtle touch of color, completing a sophisticated everyday carry for balanced performance, comfort, and style.
